reason: R8 is nothing to me and the TradeSafe escrow takes the edge off my worry about a brand-new app, so I'd test it once on a cheap comedy night for the group. If the QR works at the door I'll keep using it, but it doesn't help me with what actually annoys me, which is chasing everyone to pay me back.
objection: I've never heard of TROVE and it launches on 1 November, so I don't know if the money really lands safely or if the ticket actually gets scanned at the door. If I'm booking for six people and it fails, it's my name on it in the WhatsApp group.
would_change_my_mind: Letting each friend pay their own share through one group booking link, so I'm not fronting the money and chasing people afterwards. That would get me using it every outing.
